title: Start Here
notes: One JSON file. Hit Edit and click anything; Save as PDF from your browser is the whole export.

sections.name: intro
notes: The slanted mark means "same chord as the bar before."

sections.name: verse
notes: Section notes go here — cues, dynamics, whatever the band forgets.

lyrics: Eight bars to a line and the lines never lie,
the words sit under the phrases where they belong.
Two chords in one bar? Use an array.
Leave a bar empty and it holds what it had.
Print it, prop it, stand it on the stand,
letter-size in color, still clear in gray.
Say the feel up top and the count-off too,
and the band knows the tune before the downbeat's through.
The horn player squints and says "what key is this?"
Pick their pitch up top — the chart moves, the file doesn't.
Same name twice and the verses count themselves.
Copy a section, change the very last bar,
that's how a second chorus earns its scar.
Hit Edit when it's wrong, hit Undo when it's worse —

endNotes: Hold the last C till the leader cuts it. Enter fills the next empty bar, Tab steps bar to bar, Ctrl+Z forgives.
